proposals.title: Sleep recovery plan draft
steps: Adjust the rest schedule to get at least 7 continuous hours.
Repeat the heart rate variability measurement after resting.
Record any change at the next check-in.

proposals.title: Exercise load review draft
steps: Reduce the intensity of the exercise session for two days.
Keep the scheduled hydration and sleep routine.
Ask the onboard physician to review the trend.

proposals.title: Follow-up draft for non-evaluable signals
steps: Repeat the measurements with the backup equipment.
Manually confirm the values with the onboard physician.
Re-evaluate when complete data is available.
